# Google Chrome Browser Interface

## Window Header

- **Application Name**: Google Chrome
- **Window Title Bar**: Displays "Google Chrome" on the left and the current date and time "Oct 23 18:03" on the right
- **System Indicators**: A notification bell icon is visible next to the date and time
- **Window Controls**: Standard minimize, maximize, and close buttons are located on the top-right corner

## Browser Tabs

- **Tab Count**: Multiple tabs are open, labeled "New Tab"
- **Tab Bar**: Located below the window header, showing each open tab with a "New Tab" label and a close (x) button
- **New Tab Button**: A "+" button is visible to the right of the last tab for opening a new tab

## Address Bar

- **Location**: Positioned directly below the tab bar
- **Content**: Displays "Search Google or type a URL" as placeholder text
- **Icons**: 
  - A left arrow (back) and right arrow (forward) navigation buttons
  - A refresh button (circular arrow)
  - A Google "G" icon
  - A star icon for bookmarking
  - A user profile icon (person silhouette)
  - A "Finish update" button

## Main Content Area

- **Background**: White background
- **Google Logo**: Centered prominently with the multicolored Google "G" logo
- **Search Bar**: A rounded rectangular input field with placeholder text "Search Google or type a URL"
  - **Icons**: 
    - A magnifying glass icon on the left
    - A microphone icon for voice search
    - A camera icon for image search
- **Shortcuts**: Two circular icons below the search bar
  - **Web Store**: Icon with a rainbow-colored arc, labeled "Web Store"
  - **Add shortcut**: Icon with a plus sign, labeled "Add shortcut"

## Navigation Links

- **Quick Links**: Located to the right of the Google logo
  - "Gmail" and "Images" links
  - A 3x3 grid icon (Google Apps menu)

## Developer Tools Panel

- **Location**: Right side of the browser window, occupying a vertical panel
- **Tabs**: 
  - "Elements" (currently active)
  - "Console"
  - "Sources"
  - "Network"
  - A ">>" button for additional options
- **Notification Indicators**: 
  - A red notification badge with the number "2" (likely for unread notifications)
  - A red notification badge with the number "1" (likely for a new tab or update)
  - A gear icon for settings
  - A three-dot menu for more options
  - A close (x) button for the developer tools panel
- **Elements Tab Content**:
  - **HTML Structure**: Displays the HTML code of the current page
    - `<html>` tag with attributes
    - `<head>` and `<body>` tags
    - `<iframe>` tag with ID "backgroundImage"
    - `<ntp-app>` tag with various attributes
    - `<script>` and `<link>` tags for JavaScript and CSS files
  - **Styles Section**: 
    - "Styles" tab is active
    - "Computed", "Layout", "Event Listeners", "DOM Breakpoints", "Properties" tabs are available
    - "Filter" input field with a "Y" icon and a "Filter" label
    - "Show .cls" checkbox
    - "Customise Chrome" button at the bottom
  - **CSS Styles**:
    - `body` element styles
      - `background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);`
      - `font-family: Roboto, "Ubuntu", Arial, sans-serif;`
      - `font-size: 81.25%;`
      - `background: #FFFFFF;`
      - `margin: 0;`
      - `display: block;`
      - `margin: 8px;`

## System Tray

- **Location**: Bottom of the screen
- **Icons**: 
  - "Activities" button on the far left
  - A vertical dock with application icons on the left side of the screen
  - System status icons on the far right (including volume, network, and power)

## Dock

- **Location**: Left side of the screen
- **Icons**: 
  - Google Chrome
  - Firefox
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help icon
  - Terminal
  - Trash icon
  - Grid icon for application launcher

## System Status Icons

- **Location**: Top-right corner
